what: Real Claude Code desktop sessions (logged-in app, not the CLI) run in a disposable synthetic project with project-level hooks only (.claude/settings.json in that project) pointing at a disposable install of the hook runtime. The real ~/.claude was not modified. Global mode advisory, delegation.skills active, supervisor.outcome active, judge = live Jev. One delegation per session: Main delegates a changelog task to one general-purpose subagent.
notCovered: active global mode (prompt rewrite into the subagent): needs jev4_* agent profiles at user level (~/.claude/agents); project-level copies are refused by design (PROJECT_AGENT_SHADOWS_PROFILE)
effect of skill injection on task outcome: in every run the subagent loaded the right skill by itself from a 4-skill project
the hand-back prompt shape WITH the harness notice line after the binding fix (observed once before the fix; covered by fixtures only)

sessions.why: Agent PostToolUse is async_launched; report arrives via SubagentHandback, which this build only hashed

sessions.purpose: capture raw hook event shapes (29 events)
sessions.finding: Agent PostToolUse {isAsync:true,status:'async_launched',agentId}; report in PostToolUse SubagentHandback (subagent context, tool_input.message); Main UserPromptSubmit with <agent-message from="id"> about 70 ms later
the harness inserted an indented '[harness: ...]' notice line inside the agent-message element, so exact hash binding could never match; fixed in 7fb4ff2 / 31e1c26

sessions.qaOnlyOverride: supervisor confidence threshold 0.3 in the disposable config (product default 0.65 unchanged); the observed confidence 0.75 would also have passed the default

evidenceLocation: raw hook state and captured events were kept only in a temporary directory outside the repository (they contain local paths and session metadata); this file is the reviewed summary
